name: powertokens-media
description: Generate video (Seedance, Wan, Kling), images (Seedream) and speech (MiniMax) from your coding agent with one PowerTokens account.

interface.shortDescription: Make videos, images and voiceovers with Seedance, Wan, Kling, Seedream and MiniMax
interface.longDescription: Skills that let Codex generate text-to-video, image-to-video, text-to-image and text-to-speech through the PowerTokens API, saving files to ./outputs. Sign in once in the browser or use a PowerTokens API key.
defaultPrompt: Make a 5-second vertical video of iced coffee being poured, cinematic
Turn product.png into an 8-second 9:16 ad clip with a voiceover
